verdict.rationale: Signifyd's webhook system (signifyd-docs-7, signifyd-docs-8) lets merchants configure notifications that fire automatically in the background whenever a fraud/guarantee decision is made, which is a form of autonomous background automation. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated automation/agent builder, scheduling engine, or AI-native workflow configuration beyond basic webhook triggers tied to order events. Missing for 10: an automation/workflow builder for arbitrary user-defined tasks, evidence of scheduled or condition-based agentic automations beyond webhook callbacks, and any AI-native framing of these automations.
